name: Barbara Miller
bio: Barbara Miller (born in 1970 in Winterthur) is a Swiss documentary filmmaker. Miller studied Law, Film, Philosophy and Psychology at the University of Zurich.

credits.title: Wisdom of Happiness
credits.overview: A deeply intimate and highly cinematic documentary featuring the Dalai Lama, who, at nearly ninety year of age, offers practical advice for navigating the 21st century's challenges.
